caseName: Communist Party, U. S. A. v. Catherwood
caseNameFull: Communist Party, U. S. A. v. Catherwood, Industrial Commissioner

opinions.text: Certiorari, 364 U. S. 918, to the Court of Appeals of New York. Pursuant to 28 U. S. C. § 2403, the Court hereby certifies to the Attorney General that there is drawn in question in this case the constitutionality of Section 3 of the Communist Control Act (50 U. S. C. § 842).
